run_generate_demo: run the generate_demo script to optimize trajectories using MPPI and save results
configure_mppi_agent: configure an MPPI agent with plan horizon, paths per CPU, kappa, gamma, and filter coefficients
optimize_trajectory: optimize a trajectory by calling train_step for each time step in the total horizon
save_trajectory_video: save trajectory optimization results as GIF and PNG frames from multiple camera views
register_env_variant: register an environment variant with custom hyper parameters before constructing the environment
